name: Ambria
description: Ambria was an unpleasant desert planet, in tune with the dark side of the Force, that was located in the galaxy's Inner Rim. At some point, a human female was seen beside a lake on Ambria. It was rumored that Darth Bane, creator of the Rule of Two and the Great Plan, was killed by his Sith apprentice Darth Zannah in a duel on Ambria.
